newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African R150 long bond yield hits 16 percent.
newsitem.headline: South African R150 long bond yield hits 16 percent.

text.p: The yield on South Africa's benchmark R150 long bond hit a five-month high of 16.00 percent bid on Tuesday, as fresh selling emerged in early afternoon dealings, traders said.
However, the yield did not hold and the bond was last quoted back at 15.99 percent.
The bond market has been battered by the continued woes of the rand, which hit a new all-time low of 4.69 against the dollar earlier on Tuesday.
But dealers said there was some latent demand for bonds above 16 percent.
